articles.title: EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities
articles.snippet: Applications close Nov. 27 for an industry group that aims to draft initial standards for holding and settling tokenized securities by early 2028.

articles.title: Robinhood opens access to US IPOs for UK retail investors
articles.snippet: Robinhood’s UK customers can request shares in eligible US initial public offerings at the offer price before the stocks begin trading.

articles.title: tBTC bridge partially resumes as $120M Aave reserve remains frozen
articles.snippet: Threshold halted its tBTC bridge on Oct. 30 as operators addressed a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute code on unpatched servers.

articles.title: This Bitcoin Developer’s Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
articles.snippet: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets, giving prepared owners a chance to recover their coins and collect a potentially costly penalty.

articles.title: Paraguay Protests Over Bank Lockout Intensify as Impeachment Vote Nears
articles.snippet: Savers locked out of Ueno Bank burned their cards, booed a former presidential candidate out of the crowd, and watched Congress move to remove President Peña.
